title: What The Silence Knows (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 94bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy absurdist family Wilma Zimbabwe Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The silence is not empty — that's the first mistake you make
It's full of what was said before and what will follow in its wake
The silence between two people is the record of their shared
History playing back at a frequency that can't be declared

[Pre-Chorus]
Wilma and I can sit in a room for an hour without a word
And understand each other better than the morning message heard

[Chorus]
What does the silence know that I don't know?
It knows the things that didn't need to be said in the flow
What does the silence know in the space between the notes?
It knows that music needs the rest as much as it needs the throats
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The jazz musicians know the silence as the fifth dimension
The pause between the notes is not the absence of intention
It's the intention at its purest — the choice to not say more
Because more would be less and the silence knows the score

[Bridge]
The Zimbabwe night had a silence that Perth doesn't quite replicate
An insect-textured silence that was never simply late
Or early — it was there and it was dense and it was known
The Zimbabwe silence was never exactly alone

[Outro]
Silence knows everything it didn't say… and that's enough…
The gardens still growing — that's my boy
